description: This file implements an agent application for a device management system, including signal handling, crash reporting, device status monitoring, and RPC communication with a test manager. It manages threads for various tasks such as status checking, device info reporting, crash detection, and agent execution control.

classes.name: sProcessInfo
classes.description: Structure to hold process details such as process name array and its size.

methods.name: GetSubString
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a string based on a delimiter.

methods.name: GetHostIP
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: SendInfo
methods.description: Sends data to the test manager by establishing a socket connection and transmitting the data.

methods.name: printBackTrace
methods.description: Prints a backtrace for debugging purposes.

methods.name: SignalHandler
methods.description: Handles system signals such as SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGABRT, SIGSEGV, and SIGUSR2 to manage application state and recovery.

methods.name: SendDetailsToManager
methods.description: Reads device info from configuration and sends device name and IP to the test manager.

methods.name: ReportCrash
methods.description: Checks for crash status from a file and reports crash details to the test manager if applicable.

methods.name: CheckStatus
methods.description: Monitors device status via a socket server in a separate thread.

methods.name: ProcessDeviceDetails
methods.description: Processes device details and sends them to the test manager if no status query is received.

methods.name: Agent
methods.description: Main agent function that initializes communication, manages threads for status, device info, crash reporting, and handles agent lifecycle.

methods.name: AgentExecuter
methods.description: Thread function to restart the agent process upon reset commands.

methods.name: AgentMonitor
methods.description: Starts and monitors the agent, handling signals and thread management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that sets up environment, creates logs directory, and starts agent monitoring.
